The '''G2''' was a type of [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Its purpose was to disorient any opponents it did not kill.<ref name="DC" />
